title: Repriced x R&D-Validated x Survivable — thesis gate thresholds and weave weights
authority: Declared and sealed before any results were computed against them. Never fitted to historical returns.

rd_composite.note: Proxy for the paper RD20 cohort within the sealed universe. NOT the paper's July-June formation; labeled as such wherever displayed.

survivability.note: Hard floors, not scores. A cheap high-R&D company that dies never collects the premium. Any required field UNKNOWN => survivable UNKNOWN => no BUY.

payoff_skew.note: Price at or below fair_px_lo means downside-to-band is zero or negative: skew is undefined but favourable; the gate passes with the 'below band' label.

weave_weights.missing_family_policy: contribution 0 with a visible partial-data flag; rank is ordinal and makes no return claim
weave_weights.note: Weights are declared, not optimised. Fitting them to the contaminated pre-2026 history would launder look-ahead bias into the rank.

disclosures: The RD composite is a within-universe quintile proxy for the validated paper cohort, not the paper's July-June formation rule.
Survivability floors are declared judgments, not validated predictors of survival.
Payoff skew uses the sealed fair band; the band itself is a model output, not market data.
The weave orders names; it is never a return forecast and never sizes capital.
